memory: I have a micro‑flexure + LDV readout (~0.03 mN sensitivity). Shaft modal contamination (1.18 kHz) is time‑variant and must be separated. Splitting a single heterodyne LO to both LDVs yields phase coherence ≈0.3° below ~1.1 kHz but fails above ≈1.6–1.8 kHz. Internal LDV processing (filters/latency) introduces frequency‑dependent phase error. Current plan: retain electrostatic calibration, and pursue external/common demodulation (or raw photodiode routing) so both channels share identical signal processing before extracting k*(ω).
openQuestion: If I route both LDV photodiode beat outputs into a single external heterodyne demodulator, can I recover phase coherence <0.5° up to 2000 Hz?
